questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Customary
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Customary"** means something that is according to the customs or usual practices; it implies being typical or expected. (रिवाज के अनुसार)

 
 
• **Example: **It is customary to remove your shoes before entering a temple.
 
 
 
• **"Unusual" **refers to something that is not common or typical; it is out of the ordinary. (असामान्य)
 
 
• **Example: **Her choice of outfit was quite unusual for the formal event.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Customary' **is **'Unusual'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fashion **(फैशन): A popular trend, especially in styles of dress and ornament.

 
 
• **Example:** She always keeps up with the latest fashion.
 
 
 
• **Protection **(सुरक्षा): The action of protecting someone or something.
 
 
• **Example: **Wearing a helmet provides protection during cycling.
 
 
 
• **Habitual** (आदतन): Done or doing constantly or as a habit.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a habitual latecomer to meetings.
